description: Compute 1–12 ideal fixed/free membrane modes for a simple polygon in metres using bounded P1 finite elements. Return upper bounds, extrapolated estimates and optional frequencies/shapes. Finite spectral agreement does not prove isospectrality; no damping. CPU, direct-only; no planner binding.

boundary.description: fixed (default): drumhead, TM waveguide. free: acoustic cavity, TE waveguide.

compare_polygon.description: Optional second shape: do the two drums sound the same?

include_mode_shapes.description: Adds a ≤1024-triangle mesh with normalized mode values, for visualization.

polygon.description: Vertices [x, y] in metres, either orientation; a repeated closing vertex is allowed. Must be simple.

wave_speed.description: m/s; √(tension/areal density) for a membrane. Enables frequency_hz and notes.

name: hear_the_shape
title: Vibration modes of a polygonal drum
